evidence.quote: Software engineer focused on AI/LLM Engineering, with over three years of experience across LLM integration, data pipelines and distributed backend systems.
Built MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to support enterprise LLM workflows.
Designed a LangGraph agent that answers recruiters' questions about the CV, grounded strictly in its source-of-truth documents.
Built MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to support enterprise LLM workflows.

Implemented input and output guardrails: a cheap classifier model neutralises loaded questions and blocks abuse and prompt injection; a critic reviews every draft for overclaims, leaks and ungrounded claims, fail-open by design.
Agentic RAG, and agent monitoring and evaluation.
Added token gating and runtime limits, local observability (Langfuse and OpenTelemetry), Docker workflows and an offline test suite with a guardrail evaluation ladder.
Adversarial robustness: prompt-injection and leading-question handling, verified by an evaluation harness (`scripts/guardrail_probe.py`).
Developed Java and Spring Boot microservices for distributed backend systems.
Improved service efficiency through caching and query optimization.
Served the agent through FastAPI with streaming and a React/Tailwind chat UI; LLM access via OpenRouter with a main chat model and a low-cost guardrail model.
Full-stack e-commerce application built with Spring Boot, covering catalog, cart and checkout flows.
